anisette.title: Anisette server
anisette.description: Apple checks anisette data from this server every time you sign in. If sign-in fails with -80045, -80046 or a similar error, choose another server, reset the anisette state and sign in again.

error.title: An error occurred: {{msg}}
error.anisette_hint: Apple rejected the sign-in data from the anisette server ({{server}}). Choose another anisette server, then sign in again.
error.support_message: If the issue persists, copy the error message and reach out for support.

underage: Your Apple ID may be below the required age to use developer services.

auth: Make sure your credentials are correct and try again.

flow.step1_instructions: Connect your iPhone with a cable, unlock it and tap Trust.

flow.step2_status_idle: Sign in with your Apple ID
flow.step2_privacy: Your data only goes to Apple.

flow.step3_next_step_1: 1. On the iPhone open Settings, General, VPN and Device Management and trust your Apple ID.
flow.step3_next_step_2: 2. Install LocalDevVPN from the App Store and turn it on.
